summary: Enriched the SRS with additional functional requirements, data requirements, and constraints based on the provided domain knowledge.

additions.description: Items table: id (PK), name (string), description (text), price (decimal), quantity (integer), category (string), createdAt (date).
additions.rationale: The human explicitly provided this schema.

additions.description: The system must separate product catalog data from inventory data to prevent overselling and ensure accurate stock levels.
additions.rationale: Separating product catalog from inventory is a best practice in e-commerce to avoid overselling and maintain accurate stock levels.

additions.description: The system must use stock movement logs instead of silent quantity updates to track changes in inventory accurately.
additions.rationale: Using stock movement logs ensures accurate tracking of inventory changes, which is crucial for maintaining correct stock levels.

additions.description: The system must display product availability clearly to customers, indicating whether an item is in stock or out of stock.
additions.rationale: Displaying availability clearly helps customers make informed decisions and avoid disappointment.

additions.description: The system must use atomic database operations to ensure data consistency and prevent race conditions.
additions.rationale: Atomic database operations are essential for maintaining data integrity in a multi-user environment.

modifications.original_description: The database contains at least 8-10 pre-seeded sample items.
modifications.enhanced_description: The database contains at least 8-10 pre-seeded sample items with accurate product details, including name, description, price, quantity, and category.
modifications.rationale: Enhanced the acceptance criterion to include specific details about the pre-seeded sample items.
